question4_2_text_answer:
Dear Club President,
I was disappointed to hear that the Talk show has been canceled. Many of us were really looking forward to it. While I understand the situation, I believe we should find a way to keep members engaged. Perhaps we could reschedule the event with the guests or arrange another activity like a discussion session or a group chat to maintain excitement. Additionally, we could explore having other speakers or organizing smaller events in the meantime.
Please consider these options to keep the club members engaged during this break. I am happy to help with any of these ideas.
Best regards,
Jimmy
